regulations.notes: Minneapolis requires registrations and licenses for STR operations. STRs must comply with zoning requirements. A tiered violation system applies; properties with 40+ violation points (Tier 3) may require City Council approval for license renewal under a proposed 2025 ordinance. Minnesota has no statewide STR license — regulation is local.
regulations.pending_legislation: Proposed ordinance (Oct 2025) requiring Tier 3 properties to go before City Council for renewal
